text:
maya: quick sync — ran microbench + eval for Lucid-13B quant variants this morning. need a concise recs bundle for product/GTN.
liam: numbers?
maya: short summary: int8 (baseline FP16): p95 ~120ms, throughput ~900 tok/s, unit cost ~ $0.045 / 1k tokens. int6 (QAT-ish): p95 ~135ms, throughput ~980 tok/s, cost ~ $0.028 / 1k, QA drop ~0.7% abs on our dev QA set. int4: p95 ~160ms, throughput ~1150 tok/s, cost ~ $0.018 / 1k, QA drop ~2.3% abs.
jorge: how's the latency tail / stability? QA drop measured on what slice?
maya: tail: KV cache helps—int6 tail similar to int8 for chat-length <1k. int4 shows p99 spikes on long contexts (>1k) up to ~450ms. QA: mixed QA set + 2k GTN prompts (multiturn + factual).
sophia: product context: what’s acceptable delta for GTN?
maya: PM said <=1% absolute QA delta OK for non-critical assistant flows. longform summaries need <=0.5% ideally.
liam: recommendation (ops-friendly): route chat-lite traffic (<=512 tokens) to int6 as primary for cost savings, keep int8 for longform / high-risk flows. start at 20% traffic to int6, monitor QA + latency. fallback to int8 if p95 > 200ms or QA regression >1.2% after smoothing.
maya: example routing config (toy):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat-lite
    selector: tokens <= 512 and intent == 'conversational'
    target: lucid-13b-int6-qr
    route_percent: 20
    fallback: lucid-13b-int8
    sLOs:
      p95_ms: 200
      qa_delta_abs: 1.2
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started — lucid-13b-int6 -> 10% traffic at 2024-09-01T14:00Z (simulated).
jorge: can we tweak batching? current microbench used batch_size=8. upping to 12 gave ~8% cost drop but +15–25ms p95.
maya: agree. plan: adaptive batching max_batch=12, prefer latency SLOs for interactive routes. small config snippet:
```json
{"adaptive_batching": true, "max_batch": 12, "latency_priority": true}
```
sophia: for GTN slide: need unit-econ bullets — per-1M-token cost, expected monthly savings if 20% chat-lite routed, and simple risk checklist. can you draft?
maya: yup — quick sketch: per-1M tokens cost: int8 = $45, int6 = $28 (savings ~$17k / 1M tokens); at 20% chat-lite across current traffic this maps to ~$3.4k/month saving for pilot traffic. risk notes: int6 QA drift 0.7% abs (monitor), int4 regressions bigger and p99 spikes (avoid for longform). plan: 7-day canary, daily eval on stratified GTN prompts, realtime alerting on p95/p99 and QA delta.
liam: solid. add regression tests: 1) priming stability, 2) long-context truncation, 3) hallucination rate on factual set.
maya: will package into micro scorecard and share by EOD. short rec for product: "Run 7d pilot: 20% chat-lite -> int6; keep int8 for longform; do not route int4 for now; use adaptive batching; automatic fallback above latency/QA thresholds."
liam: :thumbsup:
